items.hook: Heterotopia is a concept elaborated by the philosopher Michel Foucault to describe certain cultural, institutional and discursive spaces that are somehow "other": disturbing, intense, incompatible, contradictory or transforming.
items.body: Heterotopias are "worlds within worlds": both similar to their surroundings, and contrasting with or upsetting them. The world is stranger than it lets on.
